purpose: Verified contract for drilling each material public legal-life narrative claim back to supporting evidence and legal authority.
claim_rule: Every material narrative claim is traceable to supporting evidence or legal authority appropriate to its type.
property_rule: Property-specific claims require property-specific evidence and verified property matching.
temporal_rule: Historical claims retain date matching and applicable legal version.
limitation_rule: Material evidence gaps or restrictions remain visible.
privacy_rule: Restricted evidence and unnecessary personal information are not exposed through public drill-down.
verification_boundary: The drill-down exposes provenance and supporting authority; it does not generate new facts or expose internal reasoning.
